CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Faith and God’s Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Faith and God’s Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Faith and God’s Promises has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Faith and God’s Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith and God’s Promises.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of the Paralytic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of the Paralytic.
   B. Use Healing of the Paralytic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Healing of the Paralytic has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Healing of the Paralytic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   C. Apply the teaching of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of God’s Plan for Redemption? (1 mark)
   A. Say God’s Plan for Redemption has no place in daily life.

   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
